Rule Definition: Reject entire file if SUBMISSION_REFERENCE already accepted for MEMBER_INSTITUTION_CODE within 24 months unless SUBMISSION_TYPE=REFRESH.
Remediation: Member must issue new reference or use REFRESH.

Rule Definition: Header TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT must equal count of data rows with RECORD_TYPE=PROPERTY.
Only one ACTIVE row per MEMBER_LOAN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER per reporting period; CLOSED may coexist historically with sequence.
MEMBER_PROPERTY_REFERENCE must not change for same physical collateral across submissions.
Duplicate OWNER_SEQUENCE with same OWNER_PAN on same MEMBER_PROPERTY_REFERENCE rejected.
Sum of OWNERSHIP_PERCENT per MEMBER_PROPERTY_REFERENCE must equal 100.00 (±0.01).
Same as VR-008 when populated.
Maximum 18 digits including 2 decimal places; no currency symbols.
Must be >= 0; if ACCOUNT_STATUS=CLOSED then must be 0.
Required when SALE_DEED_NUMBER or CHARGE_TYPE=REGISTERED_MORTGAGE and state mandates registration.
Remediation: State rule pack may elevate to ERROR.

Rule Definition: Mandatory when PROPERTY_TYPE in (AGRICULTURAL) or PROPERTY_SUBTYPE in (PLOT,LAND).
Mandatory when PROPERTY_SUBTYPE in (APARTMENT,OFFICE,SHOP).
Exactly one VALUATION row per property with IS_LATEST_VALUATION=Y.
Required when CHARGE_STATUS=RELEASED; must be >= CHARGE_REGISTRATION_DATE.
All dates ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD.
PROPERTY_SUBTYPE must be valid for PROPERTY_TYPE per enum crosswalk sheet.
At least 3 fields with MATCHING_IMPORTANCE=CRITICAL must be non-blank per property.
